var ORDER=["safari","ilha","classic","maranhao","custom"];

function nm(t,l){return typeof t.name==="string"?t.name:t.name[l]}
function money(v,l){return "R$ "+v.toLocaleString(l==="pt"?"pt-BR":l==="fr"?"fr-FR":"en-US")}
function wa(t){return "https://wa.me/"+PHONE+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(t)}
function v(x,l){return (x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x)&&x.pt!==undefined)?x[l]:x}

function render(key,l){
  var t=TRIPS[key],u=UI[l],name=nm(t,l),h=[];
  var msg=u.hi+" "+name+"). "+u.want+" "+name+".";
  h.push('<section class="hero local"><figure class="ph"><img src="'+im(t.hero,2200,1300)+'" alt="'+name+'" fetchpriority="high"></figure><div class="wrap">');
  h.push('<p class="crumb"><a href="index.html#trips">'+u.crumb+'</a> / '+name+'</p><span class="badge" style="margin-bottom:16px;display:inline-block">'+t.status[l]+'</span>');
  h.push('<h1 class="d">'+t.title[l]+'</h1><p class="sub">'+t.sub[l]+'</p><div class="cta-row"><a class="btn btn-neon" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+wa(msg)+'"><svg><use href="#wa"/></svg>'+u.cta_main+'</a>'+(t.prices?'<a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#valores">'+u.n_price+'</a>':'')+'</div></div></section>');
  h.push('<div class="tstats">'+t.stats.map(function(s){return '<div><b>'+v(s[0],l)+'</b><span>'+s[1][l]+'</span></div>'}).join("")+'</div>');
  h.push('<section id="roteiro"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_route+'</p><h2 class="d">'+u.s_route_t+'</h2></div></div><ol class="troute">'+t.route.map(function(r){return '<li><b>'+v(r[0],l)+'</b><span>'+r[1][l]+'</span></li>'}).join("")+'</ol>');
  h.push('<div class="tgal">'+t.gallery.map(function(g,i){return '<figure class="ph'+(i===0?' big':'')+'"><img loading="lazy" src="'+im(g,i===0?1200:600,i===0?900:450)+'" alt="'+name+'"></figure>'}).join("")+'</div></div></section>');
  h.push('<section id="inclui" class="trips"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_incl+'</p><h2 class="d">'+u.s_incl_t+'</h2></div></div><div class="tincl"><div><h3>'+u.incl+'</h3><ul class="ticks">'+t.incl[l].map(function(x){return '<li>'+x+'</li>'}).join("")+'</ul></div><div class="no"><h3>'+u.excl+'</h3><ul>'+t.excl[l].map(function(x){return '<li>'+x+'</li>'}).join("")+'</ul></div></div>');
  if(t.stay){h.push('<h3 class="sub3">'+u.s_stay+'</h3><p class="lede">'+t.stay.text[l]+'</p><div class="tstay">'+t.stay.places.map(function(p){return '<figure class="ph"><img loading="lazy" src="'+im(p[2],700,500)+'" alt="'+p[0]+'"><figcaption><b>'+p[0]+'</b><span>'+p[1]+'</span></figcaption></figure>'}).join("")+'</div>')}
  h.push('</div></section>');
  if(t.prices){
    var cols=t.prices.cols[l];
    h.push('<section id="valores"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_price+'</p><h2 class="d">'+u.s_price_t+'</h2></div></div><div class="tbl-wrap"><table class="tprice"><thead><tr><th>'+u.room+'</th>'+cols.map(function(c){return '<th class="n">'+c+'</th>'}).join("")+'</tr></thead><tbody>');
    t.prices.rows.forEach(function(r){var all=r[1].every(function(x){return x===null});h.push('<tr><td>'+r[0][l]+'</td>'+(all?'<td class="n" colspan="'+cols.length+'">'+u.ask+'</td>':r[1].map(function(x){return '<td class="n">'+(x===null?'—':money(x,l))+'</td>'}).join(""))+'</tr>')});
    h.push('</tbody></table></div><p class="note">'+t.prices.note[l]+'</p><div class="tpay"><h3>'+u.s_pay+'</h3><ul>'+u.pay.map(function(p){return '<li>'+p+'</li>'}).join("")+'</ul></div><div class="cta-row" style="margin-top:20px"><a class="btn btn-neon" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+wa(msg)+'"><svg><use href="#wa"/></svg>'+u.cta_main+'</a></div></div></section>');
  }
  if(t.custom){
    h.push('<section id="valores"><div class="wrap bgrid"><div><p class="eyebrow">'+u.cta_main+'</p><h2 class="d" style="font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.2rem)">'+t.title[l]+'</h2><p class="lede" style="margin-top:16px">'+u.c_note+'</p></div><form class="book" id="customForm" novalidate><label class="full" for="cDest">'+u.c_dest+'<input id="cDest" type="text" placeholder="Ceará, Maranhão, Piauí…"></label><label for="cWhen">'+u.c_when+'<input id="cWhen" type="month"></label><label for="cGroup">'+u.c_group+'<input id="cGroup" type="number" min="2" max="40" value="4"></label><label class="full" for="cLevel">'+u.c_level+'<select id="cLevel">'+u.lv.map(function(x){return '<option>'+x+'</option>'}).join("")+'</select></label><button class="btn btn-neon full" type="submit"><svg><use href="#wa"/></svg>'+u.c_send+'</button></form></div></section>');
  }
  if(t.arrive){h.push('<section id="chegar" class="trips"><div class="wrap"><div class="head"><div><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_arrive+'</p><h2 class="d">'+u.s_arrive_t+'</h2></div></div><div class="tarrive">'+t.arrive.map(function(a,i){return '<article'+(i===0?' class="best"':'')+'><span class="code">'+a[0]+'</span><h3>'+a[1][l]+'</h3><dl>'+(a[2]?'<dt>'+u.dist+'</dt><dd>'+a[2]+'</dd>':'')+'<dt>'+u.time+'</dt><dd>'+a[3][l]+'</dd></dl><p>'+a[4][l]+'</p></article>'}).join("")+'</div></div></section>')}
  h.push('<section id="duvidas"><div class="wrap"><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_faq+'</p><h2 class="d" style="font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3rem);margin-bottom:28px">'+u.s_faq_t+'</h2><div class="faq">'+t.faq.map(function(f){return '<details><summary>'+f[0][l]+'</summary><p>'+f[1][l]+'</p></details>'}).join("")+'</div></div></section>');
  h.push('<section style="padding-top:0"><div class="wrap"><p class="eyebrow">'+u.s_other+'</p><div class="grid-trips" style="margin-top:18px">'+ORDER.filter(function(k){return k!==key}).map(function(k){var o=TRIPS[k];return '<a class="trip zoom" href="'+o.page+'"><figure class="ph"><img loading="lazy" src="'+im(o.card,600,800)+'" alt="'+nm(o,l)+'"></figure><div class="body"><span class="when">'+o.status[l]+'</span><h4>'+nm(o,l)+'</h4></div></a>'}).join("")+'</div></div></section>');
  h.push('<section class="final"><figure class="ph"><img loading="lazy" src="'+im(t.gallery[1],2200,1200)+'" alt="'+name+'"></figure><div class="wrap"><p class="eyebrow">'+u.fi_eye+'</p><h2 class="d">'+u.fi_t+'</h2><div class="cta-row"><a class="btn btn-neon" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+wa(msg)+'"><svg><use href="#wa"/></svg>'+u.cta_main+'</a></div></div></section>');
  return h.join("");
}
function navHtml(key,l){var u=UI[l],t=TRIPS[key];return '<a href="index.html">'+u.n_home+'</a><a href="index.html#trips">'+u.n_trips+'</a><a href="#roteiro">'+u.n_route+'</a><a href="#inclui">'+u.n_incl+'</a>'+(t.prices||t.custom?'<a href="#valores">'+u.n_price+'</a>':'')+(t.arrive?'<a href="#chegar">'+u.n_arrive+'</a>':'')}

root.KSA_TRIPS={TRIPS:TRIPS,UI:UI,render:render,navHtml:navHtml,nm:nm};

if(typeof document==="undefined")return;
var key=document.body.getAttribute("data-trip"),lang="pt";
function bind(){
  var t=TRIPS[key],u=UI[lang],name=nm(t,lang),msg=u.hi+" "+name+"). "+u.want+" "+name+".";
  document.querySelectorAll(".wa-top").forEach(function(a){a.href=wa(msg);a.target="_blank";a.rel="noopener"});
  var f=document.getElementById("customForm");
  if(f){f.addEventListener("submit",function(e){e.preventDefault();var g=function(i){return document.getElementById(i).value};window.open(wa(u.hi+" "+name+").\n• "+u.c_dest+": "+(g("cDest")||"—")+"\n• "+u.c_when+": "+(g("cWhen")||"—")+"\n• "+u.c_group+": "+g("cGroup")+"\n• "+u.c_level+": "+g("cLevel")),"_blank","noopener")})}
  document.querySelectorAll(".ph img").forEach(function(img){img.addEventListener("error",function(){img.style.visibility="hidden"})});
}
function apply(l){
  lang=l;document.documentElement.lang=l==="pt"?"pt-BR":l;
  document.getElementById("app").innerHTML=render(key,l);
  document.getElementById("nav").innerHTML=navHtml(key,l);
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-u]").forEach(function(el){el.textContent=UI[l][el.dataset.u]});
  document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",b.dataset.lang===l)});
  bind();
  try{localStorage.setItem("ksa-lang",l)}catch(e){}
}
document.querySelectorAll(".lang button").forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener("click",function(){apply(b.dataset.lang)})});
var hdr=document.getElementById("top");
function onScroll(){hdr.classList.toggle("solid",window.scrollY>40)}
window.addEventListener("scroll",onScroll,{passive:true});onScroll();
var mb=document.getElementById("menuBtn"),nav=document.getElementById("nav");
mb.addEventListener("click",function(){var o=nav.classList.toggle("open");mb.setAttribute("aria-expanded",o);hdr.classList.add("solid")});
nav.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target.closest("a")){nav.classList.remove("open");mb.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false")}});
var start="pt";
try{var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("lang");var s=localStorage.getItem("ksa-lang");var nl=(navigator.language||"pt").slice(0,2);start=(q&&/^(pt|en|fr)$/.test(q))?q:(s||(/^(en|fr)$/.test(nl)?nl:"pt"))}catch(e){}
if(start!=="pt"||!document.querySelector("#app .hero")){apply(start)}else{bind()}
})(typeof window!=="undefined"?window:globalThis);
